SELECT
  member__tier
  , SUM(__new_member_count) AS new_member_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    tier AS member__tier
    , 1 AS __new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_semantic_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_5
GROUP BY
  member__tier
